meta.source: sky130-spectre-models repo Pi8dB worked design; re-characterized 2026-11-25 over the full 54-card bundled grid (Spectre 21.1, tt 27C, 210-point sp, series + cell-bias shunt routes; raw at /home/op/simulation/HarnessAMS/CoffVerify20261125)
notes: ron_w_ohm_um: mean Ron*W over the measured 54-card grid = 736.2 ohm*um (spread 729.2..746.0 from the per-geometry rsh folding); the two Pi8dB sizings gave 740 (0.5% apart). W_tot = ron_w/Ron_target.

coff_w_ff_um = 0.424: the MEASURED node-to-ground off-capacitance in the cell's shunt-switch bias configuration (drain at the port, source/bulk grounded, gate via 10 kOhm to 0 V), extracted at 10 GHz (converged above 5 GHz; 1 GHz reads high from leakage). This is the Cp-relevant quantity.

coff_series_w_ff_um = 0.062: the drain-source coupling cap measured in the series two-port route (Z = 2*Z0*(1/S21-1)) -- a different quantity, ~7x lower; the two numbers are both real, not a contradiction.

The old 0.92 fF/um coff estimate came from back-extracting the Pi8dB Cp optimum (Cp*=40 fF vs w=43.3 um): measured shunt Coff(43.3 um) = 18.3 fF, so the Cp optimum also compensates the bypass switch's off-cap and the arm topology -- the Cp scan stays authoritative, the first estimate is advisory.
Gate drive 1.8 V (SW levels 0/1.8); l = 0.15 um fixed for switch sizing. Full per-card table: sky130proc/nfet_lvt_ron_coff.csv.

measured_grid.grid: coarse FOM ladder (w10/20/50/100) + 5x5 grids around the two worked design classes
